# Independently authored declaration controls

These small XML designs were authored from generic declaration grammar for the
private, inert CSV declaration inspector. They are not copies, translations or
redactions of a customer mapping, generated vendor output, or licensed reference
controls. Names, columns, literals, identifiers and graph topology are synthetic.

`declared-pair.mfd` has two source columns, one target column, a required global
filename parameter and a literal output filename. Tests construct separate small
group, aggregate, placeholder, metadata and malformed-edge controls from this
synthetic seed. The invented preview is deliberately never opened.

A declaration witness is not executable support or reference parity. Grouping,
conversion, clock/numbering, input/output physical behavior and generated/host
composition remain explicit unqualified obligations. The inspector adds no
runtime profile, default filename, raw writer or record-terminator assumption.
